reason: The text fragment describes the Tenth Plague (death of the firstborn) and the Exodus from Egypt. It contains God's instructions to Moses, the execution of the plague, Pharaoh's summons to Moses and Aaron commanding them to depart, and the Israelites' departure from Egypt with their possessions. There is no instance in this passage where Hebrew leaders (Moses, Aaron, or any other Israeli leaders) lodge complaints about the Israelite people. The only expressions of distress come from the Egyptians who suffer the plague.
